advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a present-script case that stubs the gate script to exit 0 and asserts the guarded step returns exit code 0.
evidence:
tests/unit/test_gate_step_tree_skew.py:229: `f"import pathlib, sys
pathlib.Path(...).write_text('ran')
sys.exit(1)
"` — the only present-script shape exercised is a failing one
ABSENCE: no parametrization or companion test where the present script exits 0 and the step is asserted to pass — so the 'present + valid gate passes the build' post-condition is unverified
advisory.finding: The present-script behavioral test only ever stubs the gate script to exit non-zero (sys.exit(1)); it never asserts that a guarded step with a PRESENT, PASSING script (exit 0) still succeeds. A guard defect that inverted the presence check or made a present script skip/fail would not be caught by the exit-0-on-absent test (that tree has no script) nor by this exit-1 test.
scenarios: A guard edit that makes the `if [ ! -f script ]` test always take the skip branch (or a shell quoting bug) is caught for the failing script but a symmetric bug that fails a present, passing script would go unnoticed

dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Extend PATCHSET_LANE_WORKFLOWS (or discover workflows by checkout-gerrit-change-action across all .github/workflows) to also sweep _optionality.yml, _artifact-probe.yml and _eval-discipline.yml so the structural guard covers every patchset-lane workflow.
evidence: docstring claim: "the twelfth instance cannot be introduced silently" (tests/unit/test_gate_step_tree_skew.py:17)
gerrit-verify.yaml:143 `uses: ./.github/workflows/_optionality.yml`, :157 `_artifact-probe.yml`, :169 `_eval-discipline.yml` — each passed the Gerrit refspec (patchset lane)
_optionality.yml:53-55 checks out the Gerrit patchset via `checkout-gerrit-change-action` when `inputs.gerrit-refspec != ''` — the same skew condition the guard exists to catch

ABSENCE: the sweep selects jobs by GERRIT_CHECKOUT_ACTION (the right predicate) but only after restricting to PATCHSET_LANE_WORKFLOWS, so the three other patchset-lane reusables are never opened and never checked; the guard cannot catch a future unguarded scripts/*.py step there
dropped.finding: The structural guard's patchset-lane sweep is hard-coded to only two workflows (_build-and-test.yml, gerrit-verify.yaml), but the Gerrit Verified lane also runs _optionality.yml, _artifact-probe.yml and _eval-discipline.yml on the checked-out patchset. A new scripts/*.py gate step added to any of those three would run unguarded and never be flagged, defeating the guard's stated purpose of preventing 'the twelfth instance being introduced silently.'
scenarios: An author adds a `python scripts/new_gate.py` step to _optionality.yml/_artifact-probe.yml/_eval-discipline.yml without the if-present guard; the structural test passes and the skew regression ships to the Verified lane
dropped.suggested_fix: Replace the hard-coded PATCHSET_LANE_WORKFLOWS tuple with a discovery step that scans every file in WORKFLOW_DIR and keeps those whose jobs use GERRIT_CHECKOUT_ACTION, then assert the discovered set is non-empty and includes the four reusables invoked by gerrit-verify.yaml.
